entities.name: Jwar Isle
entities.description: Small, mist-shrouded island off the southern coast of Ondu on Zendikar, home of the faduun and the Strand of Jwar.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane on which Jwar Isle lies.

entities.name: Ondu
entities.description: Continent of Zendikar off whose southern coast Jwar Isle lies.

entities.name: Faduun
entities.description: Immense granite head sculptures with glowing mouths, crafted by an ancient cabal of human mages as guardians of a secret stronghold; pre-Eldrazi.

entities.name: Strand of Jwar
entities.description: A swirling beam of concentrated aether rising from a seawater-filled pit at the island's heart.

entities.name: Ondu Skyclave
entities.description: Floating Kor ruin of deadly arcane traps above the isle, former lair of the hydra Grakmaw.

entities.name: Grakmaw
entities.description: Hydra whose lair was once the Ondu Skyclave.

entities.name: Serpent's Maw
entities.description: Treacherous stretch of churning sea and lightning-lashed storms encircling the isle.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: Eldrazi whose monstrous spawn have emerged from the Strand of Jwar.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Alien titans and spawn that rose on Zendikar.

events.summary: Since the rise of the Eldrazi, monstrous spawn of Ulamog have emerged from the depths of the Strand of Jwar.
events.quote: since the rise of the Eldrazi , monstrous spawn of Ulamog have emerged from its depths

relations.quote: lying just off the southern coast of Ondu on the plane of Zendikar
Scattered across Jwar Isle are dozens of immense granite sculptures called faduun .

relations.note: site of the hydra's former lair
relations.quote: site of the former lair of the hydra Grakmaw
